sheet: Roslyn VFW Dart League Results Scan Sheet
coordinate_system: Normalized to corner-marker centres: (0,0)=TL, (1,0)=TR, (0,1)=BL; y down.
fiducial_note: Solid black squares; TL has white notch for orientation.
digit_layout: keypad: rows 1-2-3 / 4-5-6 / 7-8-9 / 0 centred; TENS keypad left, ONES keypad right
reading_rules: Each TENS and ONES keypad: exactly one key filled. Team total hundreds = single '100' flag key (left of TENS 0; filled=100); shooter max 99, team max 199. Winners: one of home/away per group. Digits printed dark gray; threshold fill coverage above digit ink.

human_only.note: Handwritten score boxes for people; scanner must ignore.
